jobs.location: Europe, EMEA, UK, Germany, France, European timezones
jobs.description: We’re on the hunt for a sharp, self-driven SaaS pro who’s as comfortable troubleshooting API and integrations as they are navigating human conversations. Our software isn’t your average plug-and-play; it has a steep learning curve so you’ll need to be technically savvy while also being the kind of person clients genuinely enjoy talking to. If you’ve got SaaS in your DNA, thrive in async/remote environments, and can juggle multiple threads without breaking a sweat — keep reading. The role You’ll join a lean, high-performing global support team working across two SaaS products, Award Force and Good Grants. Once you’ve leveled up on product knowledge, you’ll run onboarding sessions and client meetings covering issue resolution, best practices, and product adoption. You’ll also be hands-on with bug testing and reporting, feeding considered feedback to our product teams— always pushing to make our products better. We have a startup mindset.

Wir vermitteln praxisnahe Kompetenzen in Künstlicher Intelligenz, modernen Technologien und digitalen Arbeitsweisen. Unsere Programme bereiten Menschen mit und ohne Vorkenntnisse gezielt auf die Anforderungen des heutigen Arbeitsmarktes vor und zeigen, wie KI als wertvolles Werkzeug in nahezu jedem Beruf erfolgreich eingesetzt werden kann.
